Practice the cross-up

Learn the close rear medium kick with each fighter’s existing jump and timing.

Medium kick: SNES A
P1 keyboard X · P2 numpad 2

Keep the kick close. If it misses, change your starting distance or begin it a little earlier.

After a crossing, the defender must switch their away direction to block high. Crouch guard loses to a jump-in.

Capture and practice notes

All clips are unedited 256×224 frames from controller-driven Local Versus. GIF playback timing is approximate. The companion uses one clip per fighter; the separate practice proof covers all twelve fighters, both controllers and all three arenas in 72 cases.

Clips show successful setups. They do not guarantee a hit against a moving or defending opponent. Human gameplay and balance review remain open.
